new.title: Brown & Brown last/final-mile page page changed (2 new lines)
new.summary: Brown & Brown updated its COMPASS last/final-mile insurance web page with minimal text changes.
new.evidence_quote: rown & Brown COMPASS | rown & Brown COMPASS
new.implication: Brown & Brown actively maintains its dedicated last-mile brokerage brand; Nirvana should monitor their broker distribution footprint and product positioning.

new.title: Who Pays When a Delivery Driver Hits a Pedestrian While on the Job?
new.summary: Article examines liability when working delivery drivers strike pedestrians, noting employer commercial auto insurance typically pays.
new.evidence_quote: Most of the time, the driver's employer pays through its commercial auto insurance, as long as the driver was working when the crash happened.
new.implication: Highlights employer liability exposure for pedestrian accidents in last-mile delivery, reinforcing demand for Nirvana's telematics safety monitoring and commercial auto coverage.

new.title: TN High Court Says ‘No’ to PE Ownership of Law Firms But Other Options Open
new.summary: Tennessee Supreme Court blocked private equity ownership of law firms, limiting outside funding avenues that insurers feared would escalate litigation and jury verdicts.
new.evidence_quote: The Tennessee Supreme Court has rejected a rule change that would have allowed private equity companies to own law firms
new.implication: Restricts external capital fueling plaintiff litigation in Tennessee, providing a modest tailwind against social inflation and loss severity for commercial auto fleets.

new.title: Commercial insurance rates fall again in third quarter: Marsh
new.summary: Marsh reported global commercial insurance rates dropped 5% in Q3, a slight deceleration from Q2.
new.evidence_quote: Average commercial insurance rates fell 5% globally in the third quarter, compared with a 6% decline in the second quarter
new.implication: Softer broad commercial pricing could pressure overall premium levels, though commercial auto often diverges from broad global composite trends.

new.title: Nearly $1M in Pokémon Cards STOLEN from FedEx
new.summary: A FedEx delivery truck in California was robbed of approximately $1 million in collectible cards.
new.evidence_quote: A FedEx truck carrying nearly $1 million in Pokémon and sports cards was robbed in California.
new.implication: Highlights cargo theft exposure for parcel delivery fleets, underscoring the need for tight inland marine sublimits and telematics tracking in high-value lanes.

new.title: Lefty NYC Council member shrugs off warnings that her crusade against Amazon could kill thousands of jobs
new.summary: A proposed NYC Delivery Protection Act could lead Amazon to shutter facilities and relocate thousands of jobs.
new.evidence_quote: Council member Tiffany Cabán’s Delivery Protection Act could prompt Amazon to close more than a dozen warehouses and move upwards of 5,000 workers
new.implication: Municipal regulatory pressure on Amazon fulfillment in NYC could alter regional DSP route volumes and fleet operational footprints.

new.title: Collectors sent rare Pokémon and sports cards to get graded. Then thieves stole nearly $1 million worth of them from the FedEx truck taking them home
new.summary: Thieves stole nearly $1 million in graded trading cards from a FedEx delivery truck.
new.evidence_quote: Then thieves stole nearly $1 million worth of them from the FedEx truck taking them home
new.implication: Demonstrates high-value cargo theft risks in last-mile parcel delivery fleets, underscoring the need for tailored cargo liability limits or exclusions.

new.title: Walmart drone deliveries take flight in Charlotte area, raising privacy, safety questions
new.summary: Walmart expanded 30-minute commercial drone delivery to seven store locations in Charlotte, North Carolina.
new.evidence_quote: Walmart has launched drone delivery service at seven locations in the Charlotte area, bringing the promise of deliveries in as little as 30 minutes
new.implication: Context only; incremental deployment of alternate delivery modes, currently presenting negligible displacement of traditional delivery vans.

new.title: Vertical Aerospace eVTOL: The Future of Urgent Air Cargo
new.summary: Vertical Aerospace is developing an eVTOL aircraft aimed at urgent freight and remote cargo logistics.
new.evidence_quote: Vertical Aerospace’s Michael Cervenka explains how their Velocopter eVTOL aircraft is set to transform urgent freight and remote logistics.
new.implication: Context only; long-term speculative cargo technology with zero impact on near-term van and box truck delivery underwriting.

new.title: Arrest made after California DoorDash driver found dead in Tesla trunk
new.summary: An arrest was made in California following the murder of an on-demand DoorDash gig driver.
new.evidence_quote: A 39-year-old California man has been charged with killing a DoorDash driver whose body was discovered in the trunk of a Tesla
new.implication: Context only; illustrates gig-driver personal safety perils, though distinct from fleet physical damage and liability underwriting.

new.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
new.summary: Walmart enabled AI agent purchases while Amazon moved to restrict them, diverging on autonomous shopping tech.
new.evidence_quote: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases
new.implication: Context only; general e-commerce checkout tech that may marginally influence parcel volume distribution across platforms.

new.title: From Russian Oil to U.S. Supply Chains: The Hidden Risk of Secondary Tariffs
new.summary: Secondary tariffs risk disrupting interconnected oil, manufacturing, and US transportation supply chains.
new.evidence_quote: Because oil, transportation and manufacturing are interconnected, secondary tariffs could produce a far more complicated response than an ordinary tariff.
new.implication: Context only; macro tariff risk could increase vehicle repair and operational costs over time.

new.title: Public Policy
new.summary: Supreme Court petition seeks review on whether federal judges can vacate federal administrative agency regulations nationwide.
new.evidence_quote: The Trump administration is asking the U.S. Supreme Court to decide whether the Administrative Procedure Act allows federal judges to universally vacate agency rules
new.implication: Context only; broader administrative law precedent could ultimately affect how federal trucking or labor rules are challenged.

new.title: These 3 logistics firms are fixing e-commerce’s biggest shipping nightmares
new.summary: Three logistics firms were recognized as Inc. Power Partners for supporting direct-to-consumer businesses in managing e-commerce shipping and competing against Amazon.
new.evidence_quote: helping DTC businesses compete with the likes of Amazon.
new.implication: Context only. Growth in independent e-commerce fulfillment highlights potential demand from non-Amazon courier and parcel fleets, but details on vehicle fleets are absent.
